long_biography.plain_text:
Yuri Kachmazov began trading AvtoVAZ cars in Samara before creating SOK Group in 1994. The business moved from dealership operations into manufacturing through acquisitions of component suppliers, then expanded into vehicle assembly at RosLada and IzhAvto. SOK built a tightly integrated network around AvtoVAZ, combining parts production, distribution and a substantial dealer footprint.

Kachmazov served as the group's principal owner and chairman while it diversified into bridge construction, building materials and other regional businesses. Automotive operations remained the engine of the group: at its peak, SOK controlled numerous suppliers and assembled both Lada and Kia models. The group later disposed of most of its assets, leaving Kachmazov's current principal business interests undocumented.
